studies.title: Writing on oracle bones
studies.caption: Shang diviners carve questions and answers into turtle shell and ox bone: the earliest Chinese writing to survive.
studies.prompt: Close oblique tabletop study in Shang Anyang about1200BCE: one pale ox scapula and a turtle plastron with fine incisions and heat cracks; a diviner holds a pointed tool. Small angular inscription-like marks, not modern Chinese print; no paper books.
